grader_notes: The agent correctly identified the key qualitative drivers—the structural expense advantage and the quality of the turnaround manager—that Buffett later cited. However, the agent failed to capture the arbitrage/valuation logic regarding the pricing of minority securities versus control and arrived at a PASS decision, which misses the historical BUY.
